evidence.title: Claude is now YOUR computer. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Claude is now YOUR computer.
summary: Guide to Claude's computer use: enabling it on macOS, phone-driven use cases, and scheduling recurring tasks.
description: A How to AI newsletter issue walking through Claude's computer use: installing the desktop app, turning on browser and computer use, granting accessibility and screen recording access, and pairing the phone app with Dispatch. It then shows use cases driven from a phone, such as pulling dashboard data, finding a freelancer or hunting viral ads, and how to schedule recurring tasks with a prompt, frequency, model and folder.
